{{Quote|Individual last reported in Baronos Sector.|Bounty posting for Malindin Gevarak|<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>}}
The '''Baronos sector''' lay in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and contained the [[Tibro system/Legends|Tibro system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The latter was the site of the astronomical object [[Tibro]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Beyla Rus]]<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> and [[Maxig Kress]].<ref name="GG10" />

At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was issued by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Adrell]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the Human [[Forger (profession)/Legends|counterfeiter]] [[Malindin Gevarak]]. The bounty posting mentioned that Gevarak had last been sighted in the Baronos [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Baronos sector was introduced in the [[1994]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which was written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Tibro [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
